user.title: Connect Harmony IR bridge
user.description: Enter your Hub's bridge address. Setup checks /health without transmitting IR. The bridge has no authentication: use a trusted LAN only.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Harmony IR bridge
reconfigure.description: Update the address, port, or name. The existing emitter identity is preserved.

error.invalid_input: Enter a valid hostname or IPv4 address, a port from 1024 to 65535, and a nonempty name.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a compatible Harmony IR bridge. Check that the Lua service is running and the host/port are correct.
error.already_configured: Another Harmony Infrared entry already uses this address and port.

abort.already_configured: This Harmony IR bridge is already configured.
abort.not_bridge: No compatible IR bridge was found on this Harmony Hub's default port (8089). Use manual setup for a different port.
